references.text: In Isaiah 50:6 it is prophesied about the sufferings the Messiah would endure, including being struck and spat upon, which foreshadows the events in Mark 15:19.
Psalm 22:7-8 describes one who is mocked and scorned, with people shaking their heads at him, paralleling how Jesus was treated in Mark 15:19.
Psalm 69:20-21 speaks of shame, mockery, and being despised, reflecting Jesus' experience in Mark 15:19.
Matthew 27:30 describes a similar event where Jesus is struck on the head with a staff, spat upon, and mocked, which directly corresponds to Mark 15:19.
Luke 22:63-65 tells how Jesus was mistreated by the guards, including being beaten and spat upon, which parallels Mark 15:19.
John 19:2-3 describes how the soldiers wove a crown of thorns and placed it on Jesus' head and struck him, which is related to the abuse described in Mark 15:19.
